name: Jun Kobayashi
source: New transfer to Yuuichi's senior class whose infectiously bubbly personality immediately earns him a spot in Yuuichi's friend group... but while he may appear at first glance to be an absentminded, innocent airhead, there may be more than meets the eye behind the friendly tiger's sunny disposition. An exceptional pianist, his dream is to become a video game composer — but his secretive health problems may prove to be a hindrance.
